drafted_by: claude-trading-research (proposal; requires human approval before any data access)
written_before: any BL-01 run: no BL-01 outcome, count or price of the 2023-2026 splits has been read

hypothesis.note: Same hypothesis, same frozen parameters as BL-01 (A1 amendment included). BL-02 is a second, independent experiment on it, not a new hypothesis. None of the generated alternatives (ALT-*, NULL-*, ABL-*) is part of BL-02.

question: On XAUUSD data that no NEXUS study has read, is the net expectancy of BL-H4M15-IPC-001 at least the declared minimum effect, or can effects of that size be excluded?

optional_extension.condition: only if the integrity audit of that period passes BEFORE the run, decided on audit metrics alone (gaps, zero-tick days, spread distribution), never on outcomes

data.source: Dukascopy XAUUSD ticks (bid/ask), downloaded on the research PC; the cloud container cannot reach Dukascopy

exposure_check.status_found: pre-2019 data: UNVERIFIED (BREAKOUT_ACC::pre_2019.02.03), NOT_USED (ORDER_BLOCK, LIQ_SWEEP pre_2023.10.02); not part of MARKET_STATE_V1 (2019-02..2022-02), of the Phase 6 holdout (2022-02..2023-02) or of the Phase 7 partitions (2023-02..2026-09)
exposure_check.required_before_download: add a data exposure record UNSEEN for the window, with the download manifest hash

periods_rejected_as_not_independent.reason: MARKET_STATE_V1: Phase 5 discovery reuse, BREAKOUT_ACC (displacement neighbour) signals and economics from 2019-02-21, and the BL H4 selectivity counts (OBS-BL-H4-SELECTIVITY-2019-2022)
Phase 6 true holdout consumed by H006; also BL-01 lookback
BL-01 partitions; locked_validation and final_holdout are one-shot and reserved; BREAKOUT_ACC/ORDER_BLOCK/LIQ_SWEEP exposures overlap
independent but slow (about 30-45 trades per year): forward collection, not a historical window

primary_endpoint: net expectancy in R per closed trade (spread paid on entry and exit), month-block bootstrap CI95 as in BL-01

minimum_effect.status: PROPOSED, to be confirmed by a person before freezing
minimum_effect.rationale: declared now, before any BL-01 outcome: below about 0.2 R per trade a single-instrument setup with about 30-45 trades per year is not worth its unmodelled execution uncertainty (slippage and commission are not in the data; BL-01 already stresses +0.10 R). Smaller effects need 750-1700 trades (17-76 years), which no available XAUUSD window provides.

sample_size.assumptions: SD 1.40 R per trade, design effect 1.10 (within-month dependence), alpha 0.05 two-sided, power 0.80
sample_size.rule_declared_now: The pullback-to-trade conversion is a structural quantity. It is measured as the closed-trades/pullbacks ratio of the BL-01 discovery run (no outcome used). If the expected BL-02 trades are below 424, BL-02 is labelled UNDERPOWERED_FOR_0.20R before it runs and reports the MDE it can reach. The window may then extend to 2004 only under the integrity-audit condition above. The minimum effect is never changed after BL-01 results are known.

decision_rule_draft.SUPPORTED_AT_REPLICATION_LEVEL: n >= 0.8 x trades_needed AND CI95 low > 0 AND point estimate > 0 after +0.10 R extra cost
decision_rule_draft.EFFECT_BELOW_MINIMUM: CI95 high < 0.20 R (effects of the declared size excluded, an informative negative)
decision_rule_draft.never: no parameter or endpoint chosen after seeing BL-02 data; no promotion beyond INTERNAL_VALIDATION evidence; locked_validation/final_holdout untouched

gating_on_bl01_declared_now.BL-01 STOP DATA_OR_DETECTOR: BL-02 waits for the defect fix (same code serves both)
gating_on_bl01_declared_now.BL-01 GO / INVESTIGATE / STOP NO_ADVANTA: BL-02 may run as drafted; BL-01 outcomes are never used to set BL-02 parameters or the minimum effect

multiple_testing: single preregistered primary hypothesis, family of 1. The loop's 0.05/6 correction counted untested AI alternatives and does not apply (see PROP-PLANNING_ALPHA_FAMILY in research memory).
costs_and_limits: Dukascopy prices, not the broker feed; 2008-2012 spreads are wider in R terms, cost stress mandatory
regime differences (2008 crisis, 2011 peak, 2013 crash) are part of the test, reported by sub-period descriptively
approval required: RUN_EXPERIMENT_REAL_DATA and RESTRICTED_DATASET_ACCESS through the research loop approval bridge
